thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To evaluate a given reverse Polish notation expression, we can use a stack data structure. We iterate through the tokens in the expression, and for each token, if it is a number, we push it onto the stack. If it is an operator ('+', '-', '*', '/'), we pop the top two elements from the stack, apply the operator to them, and push the result back onto the stack. At the end, the top element of the stack will be the final result of the expression.
